config.description: matched window, one variable: A = P1 as-is (production launch.sh verbatim: A8 flip, 60/40 layer split, mmproj CPU, ctx 262144/2 non-unified, q4_0 KV, -b 256 -ub 128 -t 4, draft-mtp default depth, jinja, load-mode none); B = same + --kv-unified --kv-unified-per-slot 262144. Both at the measured Gen3 x1 condition on the second 3060's chipset port. Scratch port 8128, scope-isolated, watchdog 5400 s, production stopped/restore-live-verified around the window (22:36:34-22:48:50, rc=0).

workload.fixture: seeded pseudo-text 16k/32k/64k (11827/23594/47241 tok) + agent pair 2x23.6K, planted-code recall; cold->warm repeats, solo decode 256 tok, two-agent concurrent prefill and decode; n=1 per cell per boot

notes: Unified KV is neutral vs P1 for cold prefill (<1% at all sizes) and prefix reuse (identical warm behavior); solo-decode and two-consumer differences are single-run, directionally consistent with the 2026-11-15 E1/E2 and 2026-11-17 P2-regression findings. P1 remains the production default. No in-window PCIe transfer-rate sampling (sampler bug, recorded in the private report); the 167K-class prefill link-utilization question (2026-11-15 dmon 0.3-0.9 GB/s at the measured x1 ceiling) stays open for the post-fix comparison. Units are bare per the schema; qualifiers: decode/concurrency cells n=1 per boot; code_recall_correct is 10 of 10 with 0 failed or incorrect turns; pcie_width_07_00_0 is x1 Gen3, measured before and after the window with no in-window sample.
